LOCAL CHARACTER:  Located centrally in Sacramento County, just north of the City of Elk Grove.  WildHawk is a golf course in the Southgate Recreation and Park District, which serves much of the old town of Florin along with other unincorporated communities such as Vineyard, Vintage Park, and Fruitridge. Historically, Florin was strawberry fields, vineyards, dairies, and suburbs outside of the City of Sacramento.  Still busy agriculturally, it is now halfway urbanized with industrial areas including mines and rangelands. Mild, wet winters and humid, hot summers with relief from consistent delta breezes makes this area a magnet for newcomers. 

DESCRIPTION OF STATION SITE: The WildHawk Golf Club was completed in 1997 in what was a rural area of the county.  Now almost surrounded by new homes, it still maintains its new feel.  The Station is sited centrally, just off fairways to the north of the clubhouse, and should enjoy minimal disturbance and a well maintained reference grass surface.
